scope: DoRobot Studio desktop visual refinement; separate from the functional UX score. Nexus is not regraded.
evaluator: model-authored visual review supported by real-input checks; not independent human validation

dimensions.criteria: Consistent spacing, alignment, radii, containment and balanced proportions.
Clear hierarchy, readable metadata, deliberate wrapping and truncation.
Coherent light/dark surfaces, accessible text contrast and restrained semantic color.
Consistent buttons, panel headers, charts, selections and control states.
Polished empty, unavailable, selected, focused, disabled and active states without duplicate messages.
Useful space allocation at 1440×900 and 1024×768; no arbitrary oversized placeholders.
Visual feedback for real input; flexible layouts, extra windows, curation, transport and persistence preserved.

hard_gates: 40 original screenshots: five screens × two sizes × two appearances × file and simulated states.
Inspect each final screenshot; no essential clipped or unreachable controls.
Functional real-input journeys pass including flexible panels and an extra native window.
No UI shader errors or panics in tested paths.
No private information in published evidence.
scoring: Freeze before implementation. Deduct for observed defects; any failed hard gate prevents a pass regardless of total. Cite final evidence and disclose remaining limitations.
